## Original #8 acceptance checkpoint — exact reviewed implementation

Published to existing draft [PR#22](https://github.com/namastex888/trending-research/pull/22) at `f429a573ddc98ce8aef50520c2e420d1ea883f19`. Both independent full original C1–C4 and separate privacy/maintainability/performance committed-SHA reviews: **SHIP, zero HIGH/CRITICAL**. [Both complete current standalone reports and full actual clean-commit aggregate](https://github.com/namastex888/trending-research/pull/22#issuecomment-6092121217) are published in one57,757-byte evidence comment; the entire stored body was read back exactly. This is not a shortened handoff or a replay of an earlier verdict.

| Original acceptance criterion | Exercised evidence and boundary |
|---|---|
| Variants differ in interaction structure, not only colors. | Relationship-first, timeline-first, guided-question-first variants share the same real pack but differ in navigation/exploration. All twelve owned product files and current source identity were accepted by both full reviews. |
| Reader can find source and strongest counterevidence in every variant. | Actual source/counterevidence/overview interaction across all three lenses at desktop and narrow reader sizes; fourteen Enter/Tab scenarios plus six all-lens/size observations, six actual reviewed screenshots. Tests alone are not this UI evidence. |
| Selected direction has responsive/accessibility expectations and observable tasks. | Felipe directly selected guided questions first, then evidence and missing premises, retaining relationship/timeline lenses. Choice, responsive/keyboard expectations and actual focus receipts are pinned in the committed governing evidence. Guided Step3 close returns focus to the overview SECTION fallback; not a claim that every case uses the same button or that all WCAG is certified. |
| No variant represents missing or synthetic financial facts as real. | Both current full reviews accept numeric-or-null financial semantics and evidence/hypothesis separation over the same real investigation, with missing money/causal facts remaining unknown; no fabricated transaction. |

Immutable governing checkpoints: [Felipe actual choice](https://github.com/automagik-genie/trending-research/blob/f429a573ddc98ce8aef50520c2e420d1ea883f19/.genie/wishes/open-intelligence-observatory/readiness/group-7-felipe-direct-user-selection.json), [complete original acceptance/current source and clean-baseline checkpoint](https://github.com/automagik-genie/trending-research/blob/f429a573ddc98ce8aef50520c2e420d1ea883f19/.genie/wishes/open-intelligence-observatory/verification/group-7-current-original-C1-C4-acceptance-clean-baseline-and-exact-integration-checkpoint.json), [actual native focus proof](https://github.com/automagik-genie/trending-research/blob/f429a573ddc98ce8aef50520c2e420d1ea883f19/.genie/wishes/open-intelligence-observatory/verification/group-7-parent-final-native-focus-proof.json). The frozen study's historical pending sentence is superseded by these complete acceptance records, not rewritten through a third exhausted repair.

Clean exact-commit aggregate:43 tests exit0, evaluator exit0 (method3.0/descriptive/confige2e3fe2870), wish lint exit0/four files/zero broken links. Remote PR checks actual **NONE** (zero check runs/status contexts), not CI pass. No merge/deployment/deployed-revision acceptance is claimed. Source repair2/2 and separate quality1/1 remain exhausted; committed attribution did not reset them. The unchanged prototype default remains relationship-first; production guided-first integration belongs to original#9 and is not accepted here.

Local original#8 card is actuallydone; upstream issue remains OPEN, labels/date/assignee unchanged.
